description: This file defines the class DefaultContentsAdminListQueryService, which implements querying logic for content items in OrchardCore, including filter handling and query construction.

classes.name: DefaultContentsAdminListQueryService
classes.description: A service class for constructing and executing content item queries with filtering options in OrchardCore.

methods.name: QueryAsync
methods.description: Builds and executes a content item query based on provided view model and filters.

methods.name: GetSelectedContentType
methods.description: Determines the selected content type from the model's filter result or selected value.

methods.name: GetDefaultTermName
methods.description: Retrieves the default term name for a given content type from filter options.
